body:
index.html contact form now posts to IDUNA_PRO via the existing /console-api/ nginx proxy. console.html gets a real Contact form admin panel (list/resolve/reopen/delete) gated on contacts.manage. privacy.html's retention section now names the contact form specifically (90 days after resolved) and covers contact-form submitters under 'Your rights', not just accounts. Live-verified end to end through the real nginx proxy. Commit 1fa03cf.

⚓ ☃
title: PII audit: contact form console panel + repoint to IDUNA_PRO
